_title: Fiji two-authority-editions split, resolved by paired capture 2026-11-10
_widget: fml.com.fj daily-prayer-time-for-mosques (dpt) widget, public admin-ajax action=get_monthly_timetable, month=11 and month=12 -> 30+31 = 61 dated rows for Nov+Dec 2026, each with Suhoor End / Fajr Iqamah / Sunrise / per-prayer Begins+Iqamah
_sheet: the league's printed monthly sheet images (site uploads + the identical image posted on public Facebook 2025-11-29 for December), year-agnostic headers

verdict.split_confirmed: Two standing editions of the same league's times are in the wild, not a one-month typo: the pattern is stable across November and December and across the 2025 sheet edition.
verdict.direction: The printed sheet runs LATER than the widget everywhere except asr; the largest and most variable divergence is isha (6-10 min).
verdict.column_identity: The sheet's maghrib equals the widget's Maghrib Iqamah column exactly every day (both sunset+3); the sheet's dhuhr is a constant +5 over the widget's Dhuhr Begins; the sheet's isha sits beyond even the widget's Iqamah column (widget isha Iqamah = Begins+3, sheet = Begins+6..10).
verdict.banked_9_reproduced: Yes - the banked 'up to 9 min' reproduces on November isha (+9 on Nov 1, +10 max Nov 13); December alone shows max +7.
verdict.owner_question: belongs-to-version: the dpt widget carries the recipe-shaped dhuhr (+3 class) and maghrib=sunset+3 with isha Begins ~sunset+76; the sheet carries dhuhr=Begins+5 and isha beyond iqamah. A fit must pick one edition and name it.

capture_fidelity_note: The dpt Hijri column misprints the 31/12/2026 row ('17 Sha'ban -5499') - a plugin calendar bug, prayer-time cells unaffected.
year_evidence_2025: December 2025 sheet posted on the league's public Facebook on Saturday 29 November 2025 (post 1239994874821937), image captured; identical content is served today as the site's December month image (uploads/2024/06/December-2024.jpg, year-agnostic header).
